sentences.text:
This miscellaneous appeal has been filed by the appellant/claimant under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, arising out of the Award dated 29.04.2019 passed by the XIII Member,
Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Gwalior (M.P.) (hereinafter referred to as the "Claims Tribunal")
in Claim Case No. 634/2016, on the ground of inadequacy of compensation towards damage to the vehicle.
2.
The date of the accident, the issue of negligence, and the liability are not in dispute.
The findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal in this regard are not under challenge.

3. As per the findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal, due to the alleged accident dated 13.11.2015,
the vehicle of the appellant, namely Tata Max bearing registration No. MP 33 G 0910, sustained damage.

For the said damage, the Claims Tribunal awarded compensation to the tune of Rs.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:10846 2 MA-4253-2019 20,000/- along with interest from the date of filing of the claim petition till its realization.
4. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the Claims Tribunal has committed a grave error in awarding compensation towards damage to the vehicle.

It is further submitted that the Hanumant Singh Rawat vs Dashrat Singh Lodhi on 1 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193783110/
1 compensation awarded in respect of the vehicle in question is on the lower side.

entities.text: Hanumant Singh Rawat vs Dashrat Singh Lodhi
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Hence, it is prayed that the compensation amount be enhanced and a just and reasonable amount be awarded.

5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the Insurance Company opposed the submissions made by the counsel for the appellant and has filed a cross-objection in the form of I.A. No. 4799/2019 under Order XLI Rule 22 of the CPC.

It is contended that the learned Claims Tribunal has erred in not holding that the alleged accident occurred due to the sole rash and negligent driving of the driver of the Tata Max bearing registration No. MP 33 G 0910.

Hence, it is prayed that the impugned Award be set aside and the amount already awarded be directed to be refunded to the cross- objector/respondent No. 3.
6.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

7. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, particularly the nature and extent of damage caused to the vehicle in the alleged accident, this Court deems it appropriate to enhance the compensation by a further sum o f Rs.20,000/- over and above the amount already awarded by the Claims Tribunal.
8. Accordingly, the present appeal is partly allowed to the extent indicated herein-above.
The a p p e l l a n t i s h e l d e n t i t l e d t o a n a d d i t i o n a l s u m o f N E U T R A L C I T A T I O N N O .
2026:MPHC-GWL:10846 3 MA-4253-2019 Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand Only) over and above the amount already awarded by the Claims Tribunal.
The enhanced amount shall carry interest as awarded by the Claims Tribunal.
All other findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal shall remain intact.
9. The cross-objection filed by the Insurance Company being devoid of merit is hereby dismissed.
10. With the aforesaid modification, the present appeal stands disposed of.

(HIRDESH) JUDGE *VJ*
